title: Kissed by Coconut Cream Filipino Figs Halo-Halo
description: A dense, resinous, and meal-prep friendly Filipino dish featuring figs, coconut-cream-crack, and a hint of sweetness, perfect for the summer months.
instructions: In a salt block, create a layer of water chestnuts.
Add a layer of red mung beans on top of the water chestnuts.
Pour a mixture of coconut milk and sugar-free sweetener over the mung beans.
Slice the fresh figs and arrange them on top of the coconut milk mixture.
Sprinkle a pinch of salt over the figs.
Drizzle a mixture of coconut cream and vanilla extract over the figs.
Squeeze a slice of lime juice over the coconut cream mixture.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of coconut milk mixture on top.
Chill the assembly in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours.
Cut the salt block into slices and serve the Kissed by Coconut Cream Filipino Figs Halo-Halo chilled.
Garnish with ube halaya and kesong puti, if desired.
